description: Withdraw TRX or USDT from your Merx account to an external TRON address. The "amount" parameter is interpreted in the currency specified by "currency" — i.e. for currency=TRX it is TRX units, for currency=USDT it is USDT units. (The legacy parameter "amount_trx" is still accepted as an alias for backwards compatibility, but is misleading when currency is USDT — prefer "amount" in new code.) Requires MERX_API_KEY.

amount.description: Amount to withdraw, in units of the chosen currency. E.g. "100" with currency=TRX = 100 TRX, "100" with currency=USDT = 100 USDT.

amount_trx.description: DEPRECATED alias for "amount" — kept for backwards compatibility. Pass "amount" instead in new code.

name: withdraw
